results.issue: 1) timeline Prime 4 line says 'Federation marines' were flung to Viewros and that 'the marines' restrained Sylux
results.entry: timeline: Universe: Timeline of Samus's missions
results.before: a Lamorn artifact flings Samus and Federation marines to Viewros, where she gains psychic abilities and defeats Sylux; the marines restrain him while she escapes through the damaged teleporter.
results.after: a Lamorn artifact flings Samus, Sylux and five Federation personnel to Viewros, where she gains psychic abilities and defeats Sylux; her five companions restrain him while she escapes through the damaged teleporter.

results.issue: 2) timeline ZDR bullet credits the 'physical amnesia' explanation to ADAM, but Raven Beak was posing as ADAM
results.entry: timeline: Universe: Why Samus loses her abilities
results.before: ADAM could only attribute the loss to unexplained physical changes, a condition called physical amnesia;
results.after: The voice she took for ADAM could only attribute the loss to unexplained physical changes, a condition called physical amnesia;

results.issue: 3) dark-samus states the Valhalla crew's jettisoning as fact, but it is the Pirates' claim in the 'Taking Valhalla' log
results.entry: dark-samus: Dark Samus: The return – Colossus, Phaaze and the Norion attack
results.before: The Colossus crippled the G.F.S. Valhalla, a Federation battleship "crewed with green recruits on a training mission"; raiders extracted Aurora Unit 313 and jettisoned the crew into space, and the Unit's last log ended "...Darkness coming."
results.after: Per Pirate records, the Colossus crippled the G.F.S. Valhalla, a Federation battleship "crewed with green recruits on a training mission," and its raiders extracted Aurora Unit 313 and jettisoned the crew into space, though Samus later found Marines' bodies aboard the wreck; the Unit's last log ended "...Darkness coming."

results.issue: 4) phazon PED entry credits the Hunter and Fission Metroid strains to Pirate experiments; Metroid Wiki and the sibling entry credit Phazon exposure
results.entry: phazon: Phazon: Pirate Phazon operations and the Federation's PED program
results.before: The miners went mad. Experiments followed on Metroids, which yielded the Phazon-mutated Hunter and Fission strains, on Project Titan
results.after: The miners went mad. Phazon exposure on Tallon IV also mutated Metroids into the Hunter and Fission strains. Experiments followed on Metroids, on Project Titan

results.issue: 5) Claim that Aurora Unit 217 found Phaaze by triangulating Leviathan trajectories rests on an uncited Metroid Wiki line (no in-game source found; the AU 217 page says only 'apparently discovered Phaaze')
results.entry: prime3: The Phazon crisis; Elysia and SkyTown; The assault on Phaaze and the end of Phazon (GFS Olympus and the Valhalla already said only 'located Phaaze'; dark-samus 'Dark Samus (overview)' content has no triangulation claim, and its 'She found Phaaze' refers to Dark Samus's own trip in the Pirate logs, so it was left unchanged)
